narr: Thunderstorms producing heavy rain resulted in flash flooding across portions of SE TX.
ev: CR 2017 south of Daisetta was impassable due to floodwaters.
TX-321 underpass in Dayton was impassable due to floodwaters.
Emergency managers reported that floodwaters over roads near the intersection of Hilbig and Holloman resulted in road closures.
lsr: COUNTY ROAD 2017 SOUTH OF DAISETTA IS FLOODED.
HIGHWAY 321 UNDERPASS IN DAYTON WAS FLOODED AND IMPASSABLE.
MONTGOMERY COUNTY EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT REPORTED HIGH WATER NEAR HILBIG AND HOLLOMAN STREET THAT LED TO A ROAD CLOSURE.
